nina_cs: Morning all  GlacierPay weekly check-in. TL;DR: traffic flat, 5xx rate +4.0% WoW, timeouts +6.1% (nightly ingest + bulk embeddings), 429s up slightly during midday. Sending top failing endpoints + quick triage notes.
sam_sre: please list the top failing URIs and when they spike.
nina_cs: top offenders (last 7d):
- POST /api/v1/embeddings/batch  timeouts ~3.0% (batches >30), spike 13:10-14:00 UTC
- POST /v1/generate/async  5xx ~1.4% (mostly 502/503), spike 01:50-03:10 UTC (nightly ingest overlap)
- POST /v1/events/upload  timeouts 0.7% during large file loads, spike 01:20-01:45 UTC
- POST /v1/chat/stream  rate_limit (429) up to 0.9% during 17:45-18:15 local peak
- POST /internal/retry-proxy  5xx 0.5% correlated with client retry storms
leo_prod: FYI we rolled a change increasing default batch-size for some enterprise customers two weeks ago; likely amplifying embed/generate pressure.
sam_sre: infra notes  short GPU eviction on dedicated pool at 02:03 UTC; ingest nodes saw IO queueing 01:30-02:00 UTC. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/glacierpay/errors?from=now-7d&to=now Traces: https://traces.redwood.ai/glacierpay/1758888/sample
sam_sre: quick minimal repro for embed timeout (use --max-time to mirror their client):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/api/v1/embeddings/batch
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"inputs": ["<very long text>"], "model":"embed-pro"}' --max-time 12
```
maya_pm: Renewal is in 3 days. Do we consider this risky?
nina_cs: status = medium-high. Customer called out "intermittent timeouts" on their ops calls. If we show mitigation before renewal, we can de-escalate. Proposed quick plan: short-term throttle + client guidance; med-term SDK changes + opt-in rollback; longer term capacity/architecture changes.
leo_prod: proposed mitigations: 1) immediate: gateway soft-throttle for embed batches >20 (canary) 2) 48h: SDK patch to auto-chunk large batches + doc guidance 3) 72h: temporary capacity bump during 01:30-03:30 UTC for next 5 nights
sam_sre: I'll open a gateway-rule PR and run a canary tonight, post link when ready. Also turning on more granular preempt alerts.
maya_pm: I'll prepare a concise slide for the renewal call showing timelines and canary results expectation. If canary reduces spikes we highlight it.
alerts-bot: alert: GlacierPay embed timeout threshold breached (last 1h = 54, threshold = 40)
nina_cs: action items: 
- sam_sre: gateway throttle + canary PR (due: today COB)
- leo_prod: draft SDK chunking patch + customer guidance (due: 48h)
- nina_cs: renewal slide + customer sync (due: before renewal meeting)
- alerts-bot: continue posting alerts and page on >2x threshold
sam_sre: quick staging sim: soft-throttle reduced embed timeouts ~63% in load test. Will proceed to canary if no objections.
leo_prod: I'll coordinate with DevEx for SDK patch rollout and prepare a short migration note for GlacierPay devs.
nina_cs: thanks all. I'll draft customer-facing summary after canary is green and share the slide deck. :thumbsup:
